decisions.context: Cameras need defect predictions on production lines where network access is often unavailable.

alternatives.label: Local service/API based model serving
pros: Low latency: avoids network round trip
cons: Tight budget: devices need serving resources

alternatives.label: Microservice based model serving
cons: Offline availability: requires network
Low latency: network round trip

alternatives.label: Data batch based model serving
cons: Low latency: predictions are delayed

decisions.rationale: Offline availability decides the choice: local serving can keep inspecting when disconnected. It costs device resources compared with centralized serving.
consequences: Package and update a local prediction service.
Plan for device compute and storage limits.

decisions.context: Newly labelled images arrive for retraining each week, while deployed cameras may be offline.

alternatives.label: Batch-based learning
pros: Weekly retraining: fits scheduled offline training
cons: Freshness: waits for next training cycle

alternatives.label: Incremental learning
cons: Offline devices: depends on updates reaching devices
Reproducibility: complicates model lineage

alternatives.label: Hybrid batch-based and incremental learning
cons: Tight budget: more operational complexity

decisions.rationale: Weekly retraining decides the choice: train a candidate model offline on each labelled data batch. This gives up incremental freshness between weekly runs.
consequences: Schedule training against each weekly labelled data snapshot.
Validate each resulting model before release.

decisions.context: A small team must push weekly model updates to cameras without relying on continuous network access at the devices.

alternatives.label: CI/CD pipeline
cons: Tight budget: pipeline setup and maintenance

alternatives.label: Build and Deployment scripts
cons: Small team: manual release work

alternatives.label: No integration or delivery automation
cons: Weekly releases: repetitive manual work
Small team: error-prone release process

decisions.rationale: Small team capacity decides the choice: automate the recurring weekly build and release workflow. The trade-off is time spent establishing and maintaining the pipeline.
consequences: Include model validation and packaging in delivery automation.
Stage artifacts for devices to retrieve when connectivity returns.

decisions.context: Models are pushed to multiple devices and a bad weekly release could affect defect detection across the line.

alternatives.label: Rollback to previous model version
pros: Safe releases: supports recovery from a bad model
cons: Offline devices: rollback waits for device connectivity

alternatives.label: N versions in production
pros: Safe releases: enables parallel model versions
cons: Tight budget: increases storage and rollout complexity

alternatives.label: Single model in production
cons: Safe releases: no explicit previous-version recovery

decisions.rationale: Safe releases decide the choice: preserve and redeploy the previous model if the candidate underperforms. Recovery is delayed for disconnected devices.
consequences: Retain a known-good model artifact on each device.
Track which version each device is running.

decisions.context: Weekly model retraining uses newly labelled images; linking each model to its training data helps reproduce and investigate releases.

alternatives.label: Data version repository
cons: Tight budget: adds repository tooling and storage

alternatives.label: Data versioning in code repository
pros: Tight budget: uses existing repository workflow
cons: Weekly retraining: large image datasets strain code repositories

alternatives.label: No data versioning
cons: Reproducibility: cannot reliably recover training inputs

decisions.rationale: Reproducibility decides the choice: record the image dataset version used for each weekly model. This adds storage and tooling costs for the small team.
consequences: Keep dataset references with each model artifact.
Budget for storage of versioned image data.

decisions.context: Cameras may operate disconnected, so the system needs a way to assess whether deployed models continue to perform well.

alternatives.label: Model performance monitoring
pros: Defect detection quality: tracks model performance
cons: Offline operation: central monitoring may be delayed

alternatives.label: Monitoring or logging data and predictions
pros: Offline operation: device logs can be collected later
cons: Tight budget: logs require storage and review

alternatives.label: No in-production monitoring
cons: Defect detection quality: degradation can go unnoticed

chosen.label: Monitoring or logging data and predictions

decisions.rationale: Offline operation decides the choice: log inputs and predictions locally for later review and monitoring. The trade-off is device storage and the effort needed to inspect collected logs.
consequences: Provide bounded local log storage and a collection path.
Use reviewed labels to assess model performance.

decisions.context: Each weekly retraining produces a candidate model that must be checked before distribution to production cameras.

alternatives.label: Testing trained model quality
pros: Defect detection quality: gates on model results
cons: Weekly releases: requires representative labelled evaluation data

alternatives.label: Canary testing
cons: Offline devices: staged rollout may take time

alternatives.label: No testing
cons: Defect detection quality: bad models may ship

decisions.rationale: Defect detection quality decides the choice: evaluate each candidate against labelled examples before deployment. This costs evaluation data and weekly review time.
consequences: Maintain a representative labelled evaluation set.
Block release when candidate quality misses agreed thresholds.

Acceptable prediction latency, quality thresholds, and rollback triggers.
How labels are collected from production and reconciled with delayed device logs.
